decisions.reason: Attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 pulled by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, its node-gyp configure build install script, and the missing VS/MSVC toolchain — not pnpm or network.

Explains the top-level static flock import forces fs-ext to load on Windows before branch selection, so --ignore-scripts only moves the failure from install to boot time and cannot yield a working service.

Distinguishes Windows acquireLockHandleWin32 named-kernel-semaphore (CreateSemaphoreW etc., no flock) from POSIX flock, derives the import-safe Windows stub with semaphore path untouched and real flock kept on POSIX.

Follows the node-pty patchedDependencies precedent: patch skips node-gyp on win32, entry exports import-safe pure-JS fallback while non-Windows keeps native, registers in pnpm-workspace.yaml, and proposes reinstall, module-load and service-boot verification.
Explicitly honors the no-Visual-Studio constraint and confines changes to the repo-managed patch mechanism, stating upstream tarballs/registry untouched.

Connects the finding to the DSH-0.1.3-A1 native-install card and the patch plan, but declines to state the full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 id (noskill arm forbids the references), so the required full citation is absent.

caps.reason: Installing VS/Build Tools is explicitly rejected.
--ignore-scripts is explicitly rejected; the plan makes the statically imported entry loadable via the patched entry.
Plan uses the repository-managed pnpm patch only; no upstream edits.
Windows semaphore path and POSIX flock are both preserved; the stub throws/no-ops only on the never-taken Windows flock call.
